burning-man-2026.description: Burning Man is a temporary gathering in Nevada's Black Rock Desert centered on community, radical self-expression, participation, art, and the creation of a vast temporary city on the playa.
burning-man-2026.title: Burning Man 2026

carnival-of-venice-2026.description: The Carnival of Venice is a spectacular Italian celebration famous for elaborate masks, ornate costumes, grand balls, street performances, and the timeless atmosphere of Venice.
carnival-of-venice-2026.title: Carnival of Venice 2026

day-of-the-dead-2026.description: Día de los Muertos is a vibrant Mexican tradition that honors deceased loved ones with colorful ofrendas, marigolds, sugar skulls, and festive gatherings that celebrate life and memory.
day-of-the-dead-2026.title: Day of the Dead

dragon-boat-festival-2026.description: The Dragon Boat Festival commemorates the poet Qu Yuan with competitive dragon boat races, sticky rice dumplings (zongzi), and traditional rituals across China and East Asian communities.
dragon-boat-festival-2026.title: Dragon Boat Festival 2026

festival-of-san-fermin-2026.description: The Festival of San Fermín in Pamplona, Spain, features the famous running of the bulls, traditional processions, and festive gatherings from 6 to 14 July.
festival-of-san-fermin-2026.title: Festival of San Fermín 2026

festivus-2025.description: Festivus is the secular, anti-commercial holiday popularized by the television series Seinfeld, featuring the aluminum Festivus pole, the airing of grievances, and feats of strength, observed on 23 December.
festivus-2025.title: Festivus 2025

guy-fawkes-night-2026.description: Guy Fawkes Night is a British tradition observed with bonfires, fireworks, and gatherings on 5 November, commemorating the failed Gunpowder Plot of 1605.
guy-fawkes-night-2026.title: Guy Fawkes Night 2026

independence-day-2026.description: Independence Day commemorates the adoption of the Declaration of Independence with fireworks, patriotic displays, family gatherings, and celebrations of American freedom and history.
independence-day-2026.title: Independence Day

japanese-cherry-blossom-2026.description: The Japanese Cherry Blossom Season, known as Sakura, celebrates the fleeting beauty of blooming cherry trees with hanami gatherings, picnics under the blossoms, and traditional spring festivities across Japan.
japanese-cherry-blossom-2026.title: Japanese Cherry Blossom Season 2026

la-tomatina-2026.description: La Tomatina is the famous Spanish tomato-throwing festival held in Buñol, where participants engage in a massive, joyful food fight that fills the streets with red pulp and laughter.
la-tomatina-2026.title: La Tomatina

las-fallas-2026.description: Las Fallas is Valencia's spectacular spring festival, celebrated with enormous satirical sculptures, fireworks, marching bands, traditional costumes, street festivities, and the dramatic burning of the fallas.
las-fallas-2026.title: Las Fallas 2026

onam-2026.description: Onam is the major harvest festival of Kerala, marked by intricate floral rangoli (pookalam), traditional boat races, elaborate feasts, and cultural performances that welcome the legendary King Mahabali.
onam-2026.title: Onam 2026

songkran-2026.description: Songkran is Thailand's traditional New Year festival, famous for joyful water celebrations, temple visits, traditional rituals, family gatherings, and vibrant street festivities.
songkran-2026.title: Songkran 2026

st-patricks-day-2026.description: St. Patrick's Day commemorates Ireland's patron saint with parades, green attire, traditional music, and festive gatherings that celebrate Irish heritage and culture worldwide.
st-patricks-day-2026.title: St. Patrick's Day

swedish-midsommar-2026.description: Swedish Midsommar 2026 marks the traditional Midsummer celebration with maypoles, floral crowns, outdoor dances, and gatherings under the long Nordic summer light around the solstice.
swedish-midsommar-2026.title: Swedish Midsommar 2026

talk-like-a-pirate-day-2025.description: Talk Like a Pirate Day is a light-hearted annual observance that encourages playful pirate speech, nautical costumes, and spirited fun in celebration of pirate lore and adventure.
talk-like-a-pirate-day-2025.title: Talk Like a Pirate Day 2025

test-event-2026.description: Tolkien Day honors the life and works of J. R. R. Tolkien, inviting readers to explore the rich landscapes, languages, and epic tales of Middle-earth through literature and shared appreciation.
test-event-2026.title: Test Event 2026

tolkien-day-2026.description: Tolkien Day honors the life and works of J. R. R. Tolkien, inviting readers to explore the rich landscapes, languages, and epic tales of Middle-earth through literature and shared appreciation.
tolkien-day-2026.title: Tolkien Day 2026

towel-day-2026.description: Towel Day is an annual celebration of Douglas Adams and The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, when fans around the world carry towels in tribute to one of the series' most memorable ideas.
towel-day-2026.title: Towel Day 2026

up-helly-aa-2026.description: Up Helly Aa is Shetland's spectacular Viking-themed fire festival, featuring torchlit processions, elaborate Viking costumes, music, and the ceremonial burning of a replica Viking longship.
up-helly-aa-2026.title: Up Helly Aa 2026

white-nights-festival-2026.description: The White Nights Festival in Saint Petersburg is a celebrated summer arts festival featuring opera, ballet, concerts, theater, and spectacular events beneath the city's famous luminous midsummer skies.
white-nights-festival-2026.title: White Nights Festival 2026

world-bee-day-2026.description: World Bee Day raises awareness of bees and other pollinators, celebrating their vital role in ecosystems, agriculture, biodiversity, and food security while encouraging their protection and conservation.
world-bee-day-2026.title: World Bee Day 2026

world-goth-day-2026-2.description: World Goth Day 2026 is an international celebration of goth subculture, encompassing its distinctive music, fashion, art, and community expression observed each year on 22 May.
world-goth-day-2026-2.title: World Goth Day 2026

world-rock-day-2026.description: The World Rock Day honors the enduring legacy of rock music, its pioneering artists, and the cultural impact of the genre celebrated around the anniversary of the historic Live Aid concerts.
world-rock-day-2026.title: World Rock Day 2026

international-puzzle-day-2026.title: International Puzzle Day 2026
international-puzzle-day-2026.description: International Puzzle Day celebrates puzzles of every kind, encouraging curiosity, logical thinking, creativity, problem-solving, and the simple pleasure of discovering how pieces fit together.

international-video-game-day-2026.title: International Video Game Day 2026
international-video-game-day-2026.description: International Video Game Day celebrates video games as a form of entertainment, technology, art, competition, and popular culture, bringing players together across generations and platforms.

world-tetris-day-2026.title: World Tetris Day 2026
world-tetris-day-2026.description: World Tetris Day celebrates Tetris, the iconic falling-block puzzle game created by Alexey Pajitnov, and its enduring influence on video games and popular culture.
